_spec: the reference operator Ledger Conformance Suite v1.0
_description: Validates double-entry ledger correctness, immutability, and balance invariants.

zero_sum.title: Zero-sum: every transfer creates exactly one DEBIT and one CREDIT of equal amount
zero_sum.description: For each transfer_id, the sum of DEBIT entries plus the sum of CREDIT entries must equal zero when signs are applied (DEBIT negative, CREDIT positive).
zero_sum.enforcement: hard — violation must be rejected at the point of transfer creation

no_negative_balance.title: No wallet may reach a negative balance
no_negative_balance.description: Before committing a transfer, the operator must verify that the sender's balance is >= amount_minor. Insufficient funds must return HTTP 422.
no_negative_balance.enforcement: hard — violation must be rejected at the point of transfer creation

immutability.title: No ledger entry is modified after creation
immutability.description: Ledger entries are append-only. GET /ledger must always return the same entries for a given wallet, with no retroactive edits.
immutability.enforcement: hard — any mutating operation on ledger entries is a protocol violation

trace_propagation.title: All ledger entries for a transfer share the transfer's trace_id
trace_propagation.description: The DEBIT and CREDIT entries for a transfer must carry the same trace_id as the transfer response.

settlement_idempotency.title: Each transfer appears in exactly one settlement batch
settlement_idempotency.description: A transfer must not appear in multiple settlement batches. Operators must track settled transfers and reject re-settlement.

cases.title: Ledger entry must contain all required fields
cases.description: After a transfer, GET /wallets/:id/ledger must return entries with all required fields present.

cases.title: direction must be DEBIT or CREDIT only
cases.description: The direction field must be exactly one of the two canonical values. Any other string is a protocol violation.

cases.title: amount_minor must be a positive integer
cases.description: Ledger amounts are stored in minor units. Zero and negative values are protocol violations.

cases.title: Ledger entries are returned in chronological order
cases.description: GET /wallets/:id/ledger entries must be sorted by created_at ascending (oldest first). This mirrors the event history guarantee.

cases.title: Transfer creation is atomic — no partial writes
cases.description: A transfer must create both the DEBIT and CREDIT entries atomically. If either entry fails, neither must persist.

cases.title: Concurrent transfers to same wallet are serialised correctly
cases.description: Two concurrent transfers from the same wallet must each check balance independently. The second must not assume the first succeeded.

cases.title: Failed transfer leaves no ledger entries
cases.description: If a transfer fails after validation (e.g., due to a downstream error), no DEBIT or CREDIT entries must appear in the ledger.

cases.title: Rollback on insufficient funds leaves balance unchanged
cases.description: When a transfer is rejected for insufficient funds, the wallet balance must be identical before and after the attempt.

cases.title: Two sequential transfers sum correctly in ledger
cases.description: After two completed transfers, the ledger must reflect both in order and the balance must equal the algebraic sum of both operations.

cases.title: Amounts stored as integer minor units
cases.description: All amount_minor values in ledger entries must be stored and returned as integers. Floating-point representation is a protocol violation.

cases.title: Amount of 1 minor unit is valid
cases.description: The minimum valid transfer amount is 1 minor unit. Any implementation that rejects 1-unit transfers without a business reason is non-conformant.

cases.title: Zero amount rejected
Negative amount rejected
Same idempotency key with same content returns original result
cases.description: Re-submitting a transfer request with the same Idempotency-Key and identical body must return the original transfer object without creating a duplicate.

cases.title: Same idempotency key with different amount returns 409
cases.description: Submitting a transfer with the same Idempotency-Key but a different amount_minor must return HTTP 409 Conflict.

cases.title: Idempotency key scope is per-operator
cases.description: The same idempotency key may be used by two different operators without collision. Keys are scoped to the issuing operator.

cases.title: Retry of completed transfer returns original transfer object
cases.description: A retry of an already-completed transfer must return the original transfer object with its original created_at timestamp.

cases.title: Idempotency window is at least 24 hours
cases.description: The operator must honour idempotency keys for at least 24 hours after the original request.

cases.title: Balance after DEBIT reflects subtraction
cases.description: After a DEBIT entry of amount A, the wallet balance must equal previous_balance - A.

cases.title: Balance after CREDIT reflects addition
cases.description: After a CREDIT entry of amount A, the wallet balance must equal previous_balance + A.

cases.title: New wallet starts at zero balance
cases.description: A wallet with no ledger entries must report available_minor = 0 and reserved_minor = 0.

cases.title: Balance cannot go negative
cases.description: A transfer that would result in a negative balance must be rejected before any ledger entry is created.

cases.title: Balance equals sum of CREDITs minus sum of DEBITs
cases.description: The available_minor reported by GET /wallets/:id must equal the algebraic sum of all ledger entries: sum(CREDIT.amount_minor) - sum(DEBIT.amount_minor).

cases.title: Currency must be 3-character ISO 4217 code
cases.description: The currency field must be exactly 3 uppercase ASCII characters. Any other format is a protocol violation.

cases.title: Cross-currency transfers not permitted within single ledger
cases.description: A transfer where from_wallet currency differs from to_wallet currency must be rejected.

cases.title: All ledger entries for a transfer share the same currency
cases.description: The DEBIT and CREDIT entries produced by a transfer must both carry the same currency value.

cases.title: Ledger entries carry trace_id from parent transfer
cases.description: Each ledger entry must include the trace_id from the transfer that generated it.

cases.title: trace_id format: must start with tr-
cases.description: The trace_id on ledger entries must match the pattern ^tr-[0-9a-f\-]{36}$.

cases.title: All entries of a transfer share the same trace_id
cases.description: The DEBIT and CREDIT entries of a single transfer must both carry the same trace_id.
